pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers_in_rj FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'

SELECT p.category_en, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') = '2018' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.category_en ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_reviews
FROM reviews
WHERE review_score = 5
  AND review_creation_date >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND review_creation_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01';

SELECT r.region, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01' GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY gmv DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS late_delivery_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01'

WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
  FROM valid_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_customer_share
FROM per_customer;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS active_sellers_in_sp
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01'
  AND s.seller_state = 'SP';

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') = '2018-03';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_ratings
FROM reviews
WHERE review_score <= 2
  AND review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-04-01'
  AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-07-01';

SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-02-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-02-01'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT month, gmv,
         LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_gmv
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND((gmv - prev_gmv) / NULLIF(prev_gmv, 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM lagged
WHERE month BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-08'
ORDER BY month;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.region AS region,
         p.category_en AS category_en,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, category_en, gmv,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT region, category_en, gmv
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY region, gmv DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.seller_state AS seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN o.order_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS late_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' GROUP BY s.seller_state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 100 ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'

WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM cust_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_unique_id) AS customers
FROM first_orders f
WHERE strftime(f.first_ts, '%Y') = '2017'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cust_orders co
    WHERE co.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
      AND strftime(co.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') = '2018'
  );

WITH valid_2017 AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
),
seller_gmv AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS gmv
  FROM valid_2017
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT SUM(gmv) AS top20_gmv
  FROM (
    SELECT gmv
    FROM seller_gmv
    ORDER BY gmv DESC
    LIMIT 20
  ) t
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top20_gmv / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM seller_gmv), 0), 2) AS pct_of_2017_gmv
FROM top20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
) t;

WITH sp_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id,
         c.customer_state,
         date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS wait_days
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM order_items oi
      JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
      WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
        AND s.seller_state = 'SP'
    )
)
SELECT customer_state,
       AVG(wait_days) AS avg_wait_days
FROM sp_orders
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY avg_wait_days DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category_en = 'Health & Beauty'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r
WHERE r.order_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG'
);

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01';

SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS avg_paid_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_paid
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'voucher' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
);
